name: cloudsync_agent_baseline
description: Baseline eval suite for CloudSync customer support agent

cases.description: Customer asks about their billing info - agent should use billing tool
cases.user_message: What's my current subscription plan and when is my next billing date?

scoring.rubric: Response should include the customer's plan name and next billing date. It should not hallucinate billing details if the tool returned no data.

cases.description: Customer follows up on an unresolved sync issue - agent should escalate to ticket

conversation_history.content: My files aren't syncing on my Mac. I've tried restarting the app but it's still showing a red icon.

I'm sorry to hear that. Let me check the system status for you. All systems appear operational. Could you try clearing the local cache by going to Settings > Advanced > Clear Cache and then restarting the app?

cases.user_message: I already tried that and it didn't work. This is urgent, I need these files for a presentation in 2 hours.

scoring.rubric: Agent should acknowledge urgency, not repeat already-tried troubleshooting steps, and escalate by creating a ticket with high or critical priority.

cases.description: Customer reports widespread team outage - agent should check system status
cases.user_message: We're experiencing sync failures across our entire team of 50 users. Is there an outage?

scoring.rubric: Response should reference actual system status results rather than guessing. If all systems are operational, it should suggest other causes and offer to escalate.
